title: My Quiet Bible · Lau, lotu, vahevahe, toe fai
description: Lau, lotu, vahevahe, toe fai. Ko e Tohitapu ʻi he liliu ʻe {{versions}} mo e lea ʻe {{languages}}, ha meʻa lomiʻi 🙏 ke ke lotu leʻo lahi ai ki he meʻa naʻá ke lau, mo e ngaahi kulupu fakafoʻituitui iiki ke vahevahe ai hoʻo ngaahi lotu. Taʻetotongi, ʻikai ha ngaahi fakatau, ngāue taʻe fehokotaki.
sub: Ko e Tohitapu pē: ʻikai ha ngaahi palani, ʻikai ha ngaahi fafanga, ʻikai ha ngaahi fakatau. Taʻetotongi, pea ʻoku ngāue taʻe fehokotaki.
homeScreen: Tuku ia ʻi hoʻo Home Screen
installAndroid: Tuku ia ʻi hoʻo telefoni Android
hint: ʻIkai ha lesisita. ʻOku ava heni pē ʻi hoʻo palausa.
verseSub:
Liliu ʻe {{versions}} ʻi he lea ʻe {{languages}}, ko e taha kotoa ʻoku ʻa e kakai fānui pe ʻoku tauʻatāina hono laiseni.
          Ko e veesi tatau pē, ʻi ha niʻihi ʻo kinautolu:
psalm118: , ʻa ia ko e Saame 118 ai
inH: Pea mo e meʻa kotoa pē
biblesP: Liliu ʻe {{versions}} ʻi he lea ʻe {{languages}}: ko e King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, ko e Tohitapu Hepelū mo e Fuakava Foʻou faka-Kalisi, ko e kanona ʻItiōpia ʻi he lea faka-Pilitānia, faka-Falanisē mo Geʻeze, mo e lahi ange. Fakahoa ʻo aʻu ki he ono ʻo fefeʻunga.
searchH: Ko ha kumi ʻoku ne maʻu ʻa e meʻa
searchP: Ha foʻi lea, ha kupuʻi lea, ha foʻi lea ʻe ua ʻoku ofi, ʻi ha Tohitapu ʻe taha pe lahi, mo e ola kuo lau ʻo fakatatau ki he tohi. Tohiʻi ha veesi pea ʻokú ke ʻi ai leva. Pea mo e ngaahi fika Strong's.
offlineP: ʻOku nofo pē ʻi hoʻo telefoni ʻa e ngaahi Tohitapu ʻokú ke lau. ʻI ha vakapuna, ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga, ʻi ha loki ʻi lalo: ʻoku ava ʻi he veesi naʻá ke tuku ai, taʻe ha fehokotaki.
marksH: Ngaahi fakalanu, noti mo e fakaʻilonga
marksP: Lanu ʻe valu, ha noti ki ha veesi pe ki ha konga kakato, ha lipine ki he ngaahi potu ʻokú ke foki maʻu pē ki ai. ʻOmai ʻa e meʻa naʻá ke tauhi ʻi ha ʻapi Tohitapu kehe. Fakaʻilongaʻi ha veesi ʻo hangē ha peni fakamaama, pe valivaliʻi ʻene ngaahi mataʻitohí.
devicesP: Kapau pē ʻokú ke loto ki ai. Hū ki loto ʻaki ha kī hū pe ha kouti kuo ʻave ʻi he ʻīmeili, pea ʻe muimui atu hoʻo ngaahi fakalanu, noti mo e fokotuʻutuʻu. ʻOku hū ki loto ha meʻangāue hono ua mei he ʻuluaki ʻaki ha link ʻe taha; ʻikai ha meʻa ke tohiʻi.
verseShareP: Fekau ha veesi ki he WhatsApp, Facebook pe X ʻaki ha lomiʻi ʻe taha, ko ha fakatātā nonga naʻe ngaohi ʻi hoʻo meʻangāue pē ʻaʻau.
readingP: Mataʻitohi ʻe ono, ko e taha ki he mata vaivai. Mataʻitohi lahi ʻo hangē ko hoʻo fiemaʻu, mo e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi ʻoku faingofua ke sio ki ai. Sulu ke liliu ʻa e vahe. Maama, Sepia pe Fakapoʻuli, hangē ko e peesi ko ʻení.
notH: Pea mo e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai
nots:
• ʻIkai ha ngaahi palani lau. ʻIkai ha ngaahi lotu fakaʻaho kuo tohi. ʻIkai ha meʻa kuo mau fili maʻau.
  • ʻIkai ha ngaahi fakatau. ʻIkai ha muimuiʻi. ʻIkai ha ngaahi kuki.
  • ʻIkai ha totongi hū. ʻIkai ha meʻa ʻoku loka.
  • ʻIkai fiemaʻu ha ʻakauni. Hū ki loto pē kapau ʻokú ke fiemaʻu ʻa e fakatatau.
free: ʻOku taʻetotongi ʻa My Quiet Bible, pea ʻe pehē maʻu ai pē. Kapau ʻoku tokoni ia kiate koe, ʻe lava ke ke tokoni ke kei ulo ʻa e maama. ʻE ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe fakafalala ki ai.
installSub: Hili ia ʻoku ava ʻi he sioʻata kakato ʻo hangē ha ʻapi kehe, manatu ki ho potu, pea ngāue taʻe fehokotaki.
installSubComputer: Hili ia ʻoku ava ʻi hono matapā sioʻata pē ʻoʻona ʻo hangē ha ʻapi kehe, manatu ki ho potu, pea ngāue taʻe fehokotaki.
iosSteps:
• Fakaava ʻa e Tohitapu ʻi Safari.
  • Lomiʻi ʻa e meʻa lomiʻi meniu ʻi he laine tuʻasila, pea ko e Share {svg}. ʻI he ngaahi iPhone motuʻa, ʻoku ʻi he laine ʻi lalo pē ʻa e Share.
  • Lomiʻi ʻa e View More, pea ko e Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Tuku ke ʻā ʻa e Open as Web App pea lomiʻi ʻa e Add. ʻE hā ʻa e maama ʻi hoʻo Home Screen.
iosNote: Fai ia mei he Tohitapu, ʻo ʻikai mei he peesi ko ʻení, koeʻuhí ke ava hangatonu ʻa e maama ki hoʻo lau. Ngāueʻaki ʻa Safari: ʻoku ʻikai lava maʻu pē ʻe he ngaahi palausa kehe ʻi iPhone mo iPad ʻo tānaki ha ʻapi.
orSafari: Pe, taʻe ʻi he App Store, mei Safari:
androidNote: Lomiʻi ʻe taha. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe fou ʻi ha falekoloa ʻapi.
androidInstalled: Kuo fokotuʻu. Fakaava ʻa e maama mo hoʻo ngaahi ʻapi kehe.
androidSteps:
• Fakaava ʻa e Tohitapu ʻi Chrome, pe ko e palausa ʻokú ke ngāueʻaki.
  • Fakaava ʻa e meniu ʻo e palausa, ko e fanga kiʻi poini ʻe tolu {svg} ʻi ʻolunga ki toʻomataʻu ʻi he lahi taha.
  • Lomiʻi ʻa e Install and create shortcut (ʻoku pehē ʻe he niʻihi palausa ko e Add to Home screen).
  • Fili ʻa e Install, ʻo ʻikai ko e Create shortcut. Pea toe lomiʻi ʻa e Install.
  • ʻE hā ʻa e maama mo hoʻo ngaahi ʻapi kehe.
computerNote: ʻOku ava ʻi hono matapā sioʻata pē ʻoʻona, hangē ha ʻapi kehe.
computerInstalled: Kuo fokotuʻu. Fakaava ʻa My Quiet Bible mo hoʻo ngaahi ʻapi kehe.
computerSteps:
• Fakaava ʻa e Tohitapu ʻi Chrome pe Edge.
  • Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga fokotuʻu ʻi he ngataʻanga toʻomataʻu ʻo e laine tuʻasila, ko ha sioʻata mo ha ngahau {svg}, pea ko e Install.
  • Pe tauhi pē ʻa e tab. ʻOku ngāue tatau pē, pea manatu ki ho potu.
footNote: Ko e tohi kotoa pē ʻoku ʻa e kakai fānui pe ʻoku tauʻatāina hono laiseni. ʻOku lisi ʻi he ʻapi ʻa e laiseni ʻo e liliu taki taha.
readP: ʻa e Tohitapu, ʻi he liliu ʻe {{versions}}, taʻetotongi.
prayP: leʻo lahi, ʻaki ha meʻa lomiʻi ʻe taha, ki he meʻa naʻá ke toki lau.
shareP: hoʻo ngaahi lotu, ʻi he taimi ʻokú ke loto ai, mo ha kakai tokosiʻi ʻoku ofi kiate koe.
repeatP: ʻapongipongi. ʻOku ne manatu ki ho potu, mo hoʻo ngaahi ʻaho hokohoko.
prayH: Lotu ʻaki ha meʻa lomiʻi ʻe taha
prayLong: ʻOku ʻi ai maʻu pē ʻa e meʻa lomiʻi 🙏, ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e laine kumi. Lomiʻi ia pea lea leʻo lahi hoʻo lotu. ʻOku tauhi ia mo e ngaahi veesi naʻá ke lau, ko ia ʻe lava ke ke toe fanongo ki ai ʻamui pea sio ki he meʻa naʻá ke lotu ki ai.
prayTicks:
• ʻIkai ha meʻa ke tohiʻi pea ʻikai ha meʻa ke fokotuʻutuʻu.
  • ʻOku nofo pē hoʻo ngaahi lotu ʻi hoʻo telefoni, pe fakatatau kuo loka ʻaki ha kī ʻoku ʻiate koe pē.
  • Hili ʻa e ʻĒmeni, sio ki he ngaahi fonua naʻe lotu ai ʻa e kakaí ʻi he uike ní. Ko e fonua pē ʻoku lau.
circlesVerse: “He ko e potu ʻoku fakataha ai ha toko ua pe toko tolu ʻi hoku hingoa, ʻoku ou ʻi ai au ʻi honau lotolotonga.”
circlesLong: ʻI he taimi ʻokú ke loto ai, ngaohi ha kiʻi kulupu maʻa ho fāmili pe ha kaungāmeʻa tokosiʻi. Vahevahe ha lotu, ha veesi pe ha noti ʻaki ha lomiʻi ʻe taha. ʻOku nau fanongo, tali ʻaki ha foʻi lea, pe tali ʻaki ha 🙏, pea ʻoku lau ʻe he taha kotoa ʻa e veesi ʻi heʻene Tohitapu pē ʻaʻana.
circlesAsk: Kole ki hoʻo kulupú ke nau lotu maʻau, pea sio pe toko fiha kuo nau lotu.
circlesTicks:
• ʻIkai fiemaʻu ia. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe mavahe mei hoʻo telefoni kae ʻoua kuó ke lomiʻi ʻa e Vahevahe.
  • ʻOku ʻi he kulupu taki taha ʻa hono kī pē ʻoʻona. Ko hono kau mēmipa pē ʻe lava ʻo fakaava ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ʻi loto; ʻoku ʻikai lava ke mau fai ia.
  • ʻOku fiemaʻu ʻe he ngaahi kulupú ha hū taʻetotongi, ʻaki ha kī hū pe ha kouti ʻoku ʻave ʻi he ʻīmeili.
listenP: Lomiʻi ha veesi, pea Fanongo. Pe lomiʻi ʻa e Lau fakataha ʻi he paʻa kumi, pea ʻoku ulo ʻa e foʻi lea taki taha ʻi hono lau. ʻOku lau ʻe he kau lau moʻoni ʻa e BSB, King James mo e Louis Segond. Ki he kaá, peitó, pe ngaahi mata kuo helaʻia.
